on 22 March, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13629 of 2022

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Pramod Kumar Shukla,Nisha Srivastava,Rajendra Prasad Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicants Guddu and Naipal, with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No.376 of 2022, under Sections-376D, 506 I.P.C. Police Station Safdarganj, District Barabanki.

It is contended by learned counsel for the applicants that the Smt. Usha, wife of the present accused applicant Guddu has lodged the FIR on 11.06.2022 against the son of the present complainant who is prosecutrix in this case under Sections 354 Ka, 376, 323 IPC.
Later on, charge sheet was filed under Sections 376 and 323 IPC.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that out of the said enmity, the present complainant Savitri Devi lodged FIR on 26.08.2022 against the present applicants and has levelled allegation of rape.
Learned counsel submitted that it is a false case lodged against two real brothers who are the applicants.
The age of the prosecutrix is 35 years and she is a married woman.
Learned counsel further submitted that medical report is also not supporting the prosecution case.
The applicants have no criminal history.
The applicants are in jail since 30.09.2022.
Learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the offence has been committed by the applicants thus their bail application is liable to be rejected.

sentences.text: 1 Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and after hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering that it is a counter blast case and nature of allegation in FIR against two real brothers, I find it to be a fit case for bail.

Let the applicants, Guddu and Naipal, be released on bail in the above case crime number on their furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned with the following conditions :-
(i) The applicants shall file an undertaking to the effect that they shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

(ii) The applicants shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed,
either personally or through their counsel.
In case of their absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicants misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure their presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicants fail to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then the trial court shall initiate proceedings against them, in accordance with law, under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicants shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicants is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against them in accordance with law.

It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The Trial Court shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led unaffected by anything in this order.
